name: Winly
description: Explore Winly, a Python/Tkinter desktop app for reviewing trade history from a local MetaTrader 5 terminal, summarizing records, exporting CSV, and plotting equity data.
imageAlt: Winly application icon from the existing portfolio

name: 2D Animation Engine v2
description: Explore a modular Python prototype for turning scripts into videos. Its CLI and Streamlit entry points split the workflow into scene data, narration, visuals, subtitles, audio, and FFmpeg assembly.

name: Zero to Alpha Quant
description: Explore the first data-ingestion pipeline in this repository: it collects OHLCV data for equities/forex and crypto, applies retries and cleanup, then writes Parquet files. This is an early-stage project—not 100 finished projects or a verified trading strategy.
status: Early-stage · one pipeline in the repository

name: Telegram AI Bot
description: Take a look at a Python Telegram-bot prototype with a text handler that calls OpenAI Chat Completions and a Tkinter status window. Runtime behavior and API compatibility haven’t been independently verified.
